name: Berghotel Bodenalpe
beschreibung: The Berghotel Bodenalpe is an alpine hotel set in the picturesque mountain scenery near Ischgl in Tyrol, Austria. Offering welcoming accommodation for travellers, the hotel features comfortably appointed guest rooms with panoramic views of the surrounding peaks. Scenic hiking paths and first-class ski areas in the Paznaun Valley are directly accessible from the property. In the traditional alpine dining lounge, guests can savour authentic Tyrolean specialities and regional cuisine. The hotel serves as an ideal base for active nature holidays in every season.
